gloss: to fulfill a role; to play one's part

definitions.gloss: to fulfill a role; to play one's part; to serve a function
definitions.explanation: To carry out the duties or function expected of someone or something. Used for people performing their assigned roles and for things serving their intended purpose.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たす。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He plays an important role on the team.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧⟦において→において：06799_nioite⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たしてきた。
examples.english: This bridge has played a major role in the region's transportation.

notes:
A very common set phrase combining ⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧ (role, part) with ⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧ (to fulfill, to accomplish). Used broadly for both people and things that serve a particular function or purpose.

USAGE:
Appears frequently in business, academic, and everyday contexts. The subject can be a person (fulfilling their duties), an organization (serving its purpose), or an inanimate object (performing its function).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たす — to play an important role
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たす — to play a major role
- ⟦{中心的|ちゅうしんてき}→中心的：05676_chuushinteki⟧な{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たす — to play a central role
- ⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧ — to fully fulfill one's role

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{責任|せきにん}を{果|は}たす→責任を果たす：21268_sekininwohatasu⟧ — to fulfill a responsibility; focuses on obligation rather than function
- ⟦{務|つと}め→務め：03438_tsutome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧ — to carry out one's duty; more formal and emphasizes obligation
- ⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to function; used for systems and mechanisms rather than roles
